items.title: Save tmux State
items.description: save sessions, panes, layouts, paths, and pane output

items.title: Restore tmux State
items.description: restore the most recent saved tmux state

items.title: List Saved States
items.description: show saved resurrect files and last symlink

action.popup:
sh -lc 'dir="$(tmux show-option -gqv @resurrect-dir)"; if [ -z "$dir" ]; then if [ -d "$HOME/.tmux/resurrect" ]; then dir="$HOME/.tmux/resurrect"; else dir="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/tmux/resurrect"; fi; fi; dir="$(printf "%s" "$dir" | sed "s,\$HOME,$HOME,g; s,\$HOSTNAME,$(hostname),g; s,~,$HOME,g")"; if [ -d "$dir" ]; then ls -lah "$dir"; else printf "No resurrect directory yet: %s
" "$dir"; fi; printf "
press enter to close
"; read -r _'

items.title: Show Latest Save
items.description: show the file targeted by resurrect/last

action.popup:
sh -lc 'dir="$(tmux show-option -gqv @resurrect-dir)"; if [ -z "$dir" ]; then if [ -d "$HOME/.tmux/resurrect" ]; then dir="$HOME/.tmux/resurrect"; else dir="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/tmux/resurrect"; fi; fi; dir="$(printf "%s" "$dir" | sed "s,\$HOME,$HOME,g; s,\$HOSTNAME,$(hostname),g; s,~,$HOME,g")"; last="$dir/last"; if [ -L "$last" ] || [ -f "$last" ]; then ls -lah "$last"; printf "
"; readlink "$last" 2>/dev/null || true; else printf "No latest resurrect save found: %s
" "$last"; fi; printf "
press enter to close
"; read -r _'

sh -lc 'for opt in @resurrect-save @resurrect-restore @resurrect-capture-pane-contents @resurrect-dir @resurrect-processes @resurrect-strategy-vim @resurrect-strategy-nvim; do tmux show-options -gqv "$opt" | sed "s/^/$opt /"; done; printf "\npress enter to close\n"; read -r _'
